presets.label: Tension montante
presets.note: Riff de guitare étouffé, accords de piano martelés, tension qui monte.
detail: a palm-muted chugging guitar riff and stabbing piano chords, the beat tightening like a fight countdown

presets.label: Boom bap poussiéreux

presets.label: Trap cinématique
presets.note: 808 qui gronde, cordes sombres, espace et menace.
detail: booming 808 sub-bass slides, dark cinematic strings, hi-hats held back for menace

presets.label: Tracker bap
presets.note: Boom bap bâti sur des samples tracker Amiga, arpèges chiptune.
detail: a boom-bap beat built from crunchy four-channel tracker samples, Amiga arpeggios looping like a crate find
